resources.string: The keep-or-delete pop-up needs Android’s “Display over other apps” permission. Tap Allow, then turn it on for CallVault (on some phones, find CallVault in the list first). Until then, a notification asks.
Only for the keep-or-delete pop-up after a call (Settings ▸ Recording ▸ How to ask). Without it, CallVault asks with a notification. Tap to allow.
